ios.desc:
Welcome to Pandora, where you can experience a curated listening experience that’s uniquely yours. Every Pandora station evolves with your taste as you listen to songs. Seamlessly create playlists to listen to songs, artists, or genres. Easily search or browse to find recommended live music or podcast stations for your mood or activity, or discover new entertainment that speaks to you. 

Download Pandora today to get instant access to your favorite artists, live music, and over 1400 podcasts. Plus, stay up to date with the latest singles and releases, and download them to enjoy streaming music offline.
 
PANDORA APP FEATURES:

LISTEN TO SONGS, LIVE MUSIC, AND PODCASTS
- Start streaming music offline and enjoy all of the current global hits for your personalized music experience.
- Podcast and music streaming: Take Pandora with you wherever you go with CarPlay for your daily commute or your next road trip.
- Voice mode: Search, play, pause, skip, adjust volume, and thumbs up music with a simple voice command.
- Search for and play live music: Search by artist, song, genre, and more.
- Enjoy your own personalized music or podcast experience from anywhere in the world’s most powerful music discovery platform.

PLAYLIST MAKER AND PERSONALIZATION
- Listen to songs and curate your playlist: Add your favorite songs to your playlist maker in seconds.
- Add your live music or other song choices and edit the order of your music to easily manage your playlist.
- Enjoy our playlist maker and start streaming music offline.

PANDORA MODES
- Meet Pandora Modes: Choose from six different modes to switch up the kind of music you're hearing:
- My Station: Listen to songs with the station experience you know and love.
- Crowd Faves: Hear the most thumbed-up songs by other listeners.
- Deep Cuts: Hear less familiar songs or live music from station artists.
- Discovery: Listen to songs from artists who don't usually play on this station.
- Newly Released: Hear the newest releases from station artists.
- Artist Only: Hear songs from the station artist.
 
CHOOSE HOW YOU WANT TO LISTEN
- Pandora Free: Discover personalized stations that make sense. Watch an ad to search and play any track or podcast, plus enjoy unlimited skips.

Let's pretend for a second that you're right and that there's about 10,000 people who want background streaming, that's 0.01% of the total number of estimated worldwide users (75 million) on the iTunes platform. A percentage that small is too small for me to be "violently wrong". I suspect that 80% of users have never even heard of Pandora on or off the iPhone.

Curious, I went to the iTunes app page for Pandora: http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/pandora-radio/id284035177

Two points:

1. See that "/us/" in the URL? The Pandora Radio app is ONLY available in the U.S. This is confirmed when I went to the "Pandora Media, Inc. Web Site" link:

"We are deeply, deeply sorry to say that due to licensing constraints, we can no longer allow access to Pandora for listeners located outside of the U.S. We will continue to work diligently to realize the vision of a truly global Pandora, but for the time being we are required to restrict its use. We are very sad to have to do this, but there is no other alternative."

So, off the top, only about 50% - 55% of all iPhone OS users can care about background streaming with Pandora due to the geographic limitations involved. (Call it about 41 million possible users.) We're still only up to 0.03% of possible users if we use your number.
